shared_elements: a row of repeated similar figures aligned along a horizontal register
horizontal band of repeated small motifs (rosettes / arched loops) framing the field
band of short vertical strokes or fringe-like divider
figures/creatures all oriented in the same direction
justification: Both surfaces organise low-relief profile figures into a horizontal row bounded by a band of repeated small motifs, a very generic register convention that any relief tradition might reach independently. The depicted content differs entirely: A shows robed human courtiers with elaborate headdresses holding cups, staffs and gestures of greeting, while B shows animals only \u2014 quadruped predators, birds and a snake-like form \u2014 with no human figures, no held objects and no interaction between the creatures.
